details: Verbalizing structured table rows into fluent natural-language descriptions, e.g. turning game statistics into a recap. It tests content selection and faithful surface realization.

explainer.lead: Table-to-text generation is verbalizing structured table rows into fluent natural-language descriptions. It matters because it tests content selection and faithful surface realization.

tiers.eli5: It's turning a row of numbers in a table into a readable sentence, like turning game stats into a short recap.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers build systems that select the relevant content from table rows and realize it as fluent text. A pitfall is faithfulness: the surface text must match what the table actually says.
tiers.paperLevel: Generating fluent natural-language descriptions from structured table rows, testing content selection and faithful surface realization. Limits: the output must stay faithful to the table content.

explainer.example: Game statistics held in table rows are turned into a written recap of the game.
